# Amen Allah Ben Aissa

## About
I'm a software engineer and data science student driven by curiosity about how systems work at every level. I build games, tools, and applications while diving deep into the underlying technologies. I'm passionate about solving complex problems across different domains and creating software that delivers real value.

## Experience

### Software Engineering Intern at Tanit Consulting AB (FrostLink) (Jul 2026 - Aug 2026)
- Nine-week internship on FrostLink, a React Native and Expo app for skiers and snowboarders; three releases (1.1.2 to 1.1.4) went out during it, with part-time work after.
- Rebuilt the trip-matching engine as a weighted score over seven dimensions with a broadening ladder and a 35% fit floor, and took the Firestore rules from a few permissive checks to 387 lines.
- [FrostLink](https://frostlink.ski/)
- [Project Page](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/frostlink.html)
- [Internship Report](https://logmoon.github.io/assets/files/docs/frostlink/frostlink-internship-report.pdf)

### Internship at SQUARE-IT (Jul 2025 - Sep 2025)
- Built a career-management module for the HRMaps HRMS during a three-month internship in ASP.NET and Angular, including CareerIntelligenceService, which turns performance reviews, skills and tenure into promotion-readiness scores, attrition-risk predictions and skill-gap recommendations.
- Designed a role-aware approval workflow where manager-initiated promotion and transfer requests skip the standard queue and route directly to HR.
- [Square-IT](https://www.linkedin.com/in/square-it-96b04b129/)
- [Project Page](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/internship-hrms.html)
- [Internship Report](https://logmoon.github.io/assets/files/docs/internship-hrms/hrms-internship-report.pdf)

## Projects

### [FrostLink](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/frostlink.html)
Tags: React Native, TypeScript, Firebase, Expo, Mobile Development
Nine-week internship at Tanit Consulting AB, July to August 2026: rebuilt the trip-matching engine, wrote the 387-line Firestore rules file, and built Piste, the review workflow I ran on 41 of my review passes.

### [LLM Agents Traffic Controller (MARL)](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/marl-traffic.html)
Tags: Python, LLM, SUMO, Reinforcement Learning, FastAPI, React
A language model layer for traffic signals: three role agents, a supervisor, an arbiter and a safety shield on top of Eclipse SUMO, with the latency work and the benchmark against Max-Pressure on a real Tunisian district.

### [Pilot - Internship Discovery & Application Pipeline](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/pilot.html)
Tags: Python, LLM, Playwright, SQLite, CLI
The tool I use to find and apply for internships: keyless discovery across job and ATS boards, LLM fit scoring against my own profile, per-application CV and cover-letter tailoring, and browser autofill that leaves the submit click to me.

### [DQN From Scratch](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/dqn-from-scratch.html)
Tags: Reinforcement Learning, C, Deep Q-Network, Neural Networks, Sokol
Deep Q-Network implemented from scratch in C on a custom Sokol game stack: hand-written forward pass and backprop, experience replay, target networks and a training curriculum, applied to Pong.
- [Github (Source Code)](https://github.com/logmoon/dqn-implementation-from-scratch)

### [CredVault](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/credvault.html)
Tags: Rust, Tauri, Encryption, Desktop Application, CI/CD, React
Local-first, zero-knowledge credential manager shipped as a Rust and Tauri desktop app: Argon2id and AES-256-GCM, one encrypted file, no network calls, installers for Linux and Windows via CI/CD.
- [Github (Source Code)](https://github.com/logmoon/credvault)
- [Github Releases (Download)](https://github.com/logmoon/credvault/releases)

### [Stock Boy](https://logmoon.github.io/projects/Stock_Boy.html)
Tags: Unity, C#, Commercial Game, 2D Game, Team Lead
Commercial 2D action-adventure in Unity, developed with Novel Bomb as sole in-engine programmer and lead developer on a 4-person team.
- [Website](https://novelbomb.com/stock-boy)
- [Itch (Play Demo)](https://novel-bomb.itch.io/stock-boy)
